BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain barman)
(:requirements :typing)
(:types
    hand shaker shot ingredient cocktail dispenser level - object
    container - object
)
(:constants)
(:predicates
    (ontable ?c - container)
    (holding ?h - hand ?c - container)
    (handempty ?h - hand)
    (clean ?c - container)
    (empty ?c - container)
    (contains ?c - container ?b - object)
    (dispenses ?d - dispenser ?i - ingredient)
    (shaker-empty-level ?s - shaker ?l - level)
    (shaker-level ?s - shaker ?l - level)
    (next ?l1 - level ?l2 - level)
    (unshaked ?s - shaker)
    (shaked ?s - shaker)
    (cocktail-part1 ?c - cocktail ?i - ingredient)
    (cocktail-part2 ?c - cocktail ?i - ingredient)
    (used ?s - shaker)
)

(:action grasp
    :parameters (?h - hand ?c - container)
    :precondition (and (handempty ?h) (ontable ?c))
    :effect (and (holding ?h ?c) (not (ontable ?c)) (not (handempty ?h)))
)

(:action leave
    :parameters (?h - hand ?c - container)
    :precondition (holding ?h ?c)
    :effect (and (ontable ?c) (not (holding ?h ?c)) (handempty ?h))
)

(:action fill-shot
    :parameters (?h - hand ?s - shot ?i - ingredient ?d - dispenser ?other - hand)
    :precondition (and (holding ?h ?s) (handempty ?other) (empty ?s) (clean ?s) (dispenses ?d ?i) (not (= ?h ?other)))
    :effect (and (not (empty ?s)) (contains ?s ?i) (not (clean ?s)))
)

(:action refill-shot
    :parameters (?h - hand ?s - shot ?i - ingredient ?d - dispenser ?other - hand)
    :precondition (and (holding ?h ?s) (handempty ?other) (empty ?s) (contains ?s ?i) (dispenses ?d ?i) (not (= ?h ?other)))
    :effect (and (not (empty ?s)) (contains ?s ?i))
)

(:action empty-shot
    :parameters (?h - hand ?s - shot ?b - object)
    :precondition (and (holding ?h ?s) (contains ?s ?b))
    :effect (and (not (contains ?s ?b)) (empty ?s))
)

(:action clean-shot
    :parameters (?h - hand ?s - shot ?other - hand)
    :precondition (and (holding ?h ?s) (empty ?s) (handempty ?other) (not (= ?h ?other)))
    :effect (and (clean ?s))
)

(:action pour-shot-to-clean-shaker
    :parameters (?h - hand ?s - shot ?i - ingredient ?sh - shaker ?l - level ?nl - level)
    :precondition (and (holding ?h ?s) (contains ?s ?i) (empty ?sh) (clean ?sh) (shaker-level ?sh ?l) (next ?l ?nl))
    :effect (and (not (contains ?s ?i)) (empty ?s) (contains ?sh ?i) (not (empty ?sh)) (not (clean ?sh))
                 (unshaked ?sh) (used ?sh)
                 (not (shaker-level ?sh ?l)) (shaker-level ?sh ?nl))
)

(:action pour-shot-to-used-shaker
    :parameters (?h - hand ?s - shot ?i - ingredient ?sh - shaker ?l - level ?nl - level ?maxl - level)
    :precondition (and (holding ?h ?s) (contains ?s ?i) (used ?sh) (unshaked ?sh)
                        (shaker-level ?sh ?l) (next ?l ?nl) (not (shaker-empty-level ?sh ?l))
                        (not (= ?l ?maxl)))
    :effect (and (not (contains ?s ?i)) (empty ?s) (contains ?sh ?i)
                 (not (shaker-level ?sh ?l)) (shaker-level ?sh ?nl))
)

(:action empty-shaker
    :parameters (?h - hand ?sh - shaker ?b - cocktail ?l - level ?el - level)
    :precondition (and (holding ?h ?sh) (contains ?sh ?b) (shaked ?sh) (shaker-level ?sh ?l) (shaker-empty-level ?sh ?el))
    :effect (and (not (contains ?sh ?b)) (empty ?sh) (not (shaked ?sh))
                 (not (shaker-level ?sh ?l)) (shaker-level ?sh ?el))
)

(:action clean-shaker
    :parameters (?h - hand ?sh - shaker ?other - hand)
    :precondition (and (holding ?h ?sh) (empty ?sh) (handempty ?other) (not (= ?h ?other)))
    :effect (and (clean ?sh) (not (used ?sh)))
)

(:action shake
    :parameters (?h - hand ?sh - shaker ?other - hand ?i1 - ingredient ?i2 - ingredient ?c - cocktail)
    :precondition (and (holding ?h ?sh) (handempty ?other) (unshaked ?sh)
                        (contains ?sh ?i1) (contains ?sh ?i2)
                        (cocktail-part1 ?c ?i1) (cocktail-part2 ?c ?i2) (not (= ?h ?other)))
    :effect (and (not (contains ?sh ?i1)) (not (contains ?sh ?i2))
                 (contains ?sh ?c) (shaked ?sh) (not (unshaked ?sh)))
)

(:action pour-shaker-to-shot
    :parameters (?h - hand ?sh - shaker ?s - shot ?c - cocktail ?l - level ?nl - level)
    :precondition (and (holding ?h ?sh) (contains ?sh ?c) (shaked ?sh) (empty ?s) (clean ?s)
                        (shaker-level ?sh ?l) (next ?nl ?l))
    :effect (and (contains ?s ?c) (not (empty ?s)) (not (clean ?s))
                 (shaker-level ?sh ?nl) (not (shaker-level ?sh ?l)))
)

)
END DOMAIN
